text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:

2. **#4419**: from Moss's undated "North cheat sheet". Thea's ticket on gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 product support.

Things to check before you paste these into the weekly notes:
- The cheat sheet is undated, so I can't tell whether #4419 is current.
- A note by Marcus, not Moss, also cites #4419 but describes it as Gate 3 printer lag. The two descriptions may not refer to the same issue.
- The brain search was keyword-only, so I may have missed notes that describe a ticket without using the word "ticket". The Moss notes folder on the share is empty, so these two are all I found.

I can't write to the weekly notes file, so you'll need to paste the list in yourself.
